module_signals.finding: NO NEW COMPANY EVIDENCE. The latest reported quarter is still Q3 FY26 (2026-06-24). Q4 FY26 is confirmed for 2026-09-30, after this as_of. Everything company-specific is carried forward unchanged. This is the only name in the batch where the T6 guidance-recency warning fires, and it fires correctly.

Mechanism carried and corroborated from outside: HBM/DRAM demand is being confirmed by peers (SanDisk Q4 FY26 blowout, Seagate FQ4 revenue $3.63B +48.5% YoY). Read-across is supportive, but it is read-across, not Micron's own numbers.
Unchanged. HBM is the genuine high-barrier segment; the commodity DRAM majority is not. The 16 multi-year Strategic Customer Agreements remain a real but partial offset to cyclicality.

Carried unchanged from Q3 FY26: revenue $41.46B, non-GAAP GM 84.9%, non-GAAP EPS $25.11, OCF $25.39B, adj FCF $18.3B, DRAM $31.3B. Q4 guide $50.0B / ~86% GM / $31.00 EPS. Balance sheet $26.02B cash against $6.38B debt. Nothing here has been disconfirmed - it simply has not been updated.

WORSENED SINCE JULY, and this is the only leg that moved on evidence. In July the supply response was anticipated; it is now board-approved and financed. SK Hynix approved $38B of new fabs on 2026-08-07; Samsung and SK Hynix are together committing ~800 trillion won (~$518B) to new Korean capacity; Micron's own FY2027 capex is guided above $10B per quarter. Meanwhile conventional DRAM contract-price momentum decelerates from +90-95% QoQ (1Q26) to a forecast +3-8% (4Q26). Capacity being funded into decelerating price momentum is the textbook late-cycle configuration.

Price $1,016.59, +3.8% since the prior card. Against the carried normalized band the stock moved the WRONG way: 2.31x base fair (was 2.23x) and 1.07x bull fair (was 1.03x) - it is now slightly ABOVE the honest bull case rather than at it. Forward P/E of ~7.07x looks cheap and is the classic memory value trap: this stock prints its lowest multiples on peak EPS. Reference points from Micron's own history: FY2022 peak EPS $7.75 became FY2023 EPS of -$5.34.

capital_cycle.read: Upgraded in confidence, not in direction, since July. The supply response is no longer a forecast: it is approved and funded. Turn timing remains unknown and we do not bet on it.

watch_to_starter_trigger: Price into ~$650 or below WITH the normalized band intact. Separately, a genuine upward revision to the normalized band would require the SCA/HBM floor to hold through a DOWN pricing quarter - which by definition cannot be observed while prices are still rising.
runner_dissent: I want to flag a tension in the carried band rather than quietly fix it. Normalized base EPS of $22/year sits against a current quarterly run-rate of $25-31, i.e. it assumes roughly a 93% decline in earnings power. That was a defensible mid-cycle reversion before HBM and before 16 multi-year SCAs; it may now be too harsh, and if it is, base fair value of $440 is too low and the $650 entry is unreachably strict. But the evidence that would justify raising it can only be generated in a down-pricing quarter, and none has occurred. So: flagged, not changed. If Q4 FY26 on 2026-09-30 comes with a Q1 FY27 guide that holds margin against decelerating contract prices, that is the first real datapoint for re-basing the band upward.
